# Runtime dependencies — only what serving the model needs.
# For training and evaluation, use requirements-dev.txt instead.

# Web
flask>=3.0.0
flask-cors>=4.0.0
gunicorn>=21.2.0

# Inference
# onnxruntime rather than tensorflow: ~20MB against ~400MB, which is what keeps
# the deployed bundle under Vercel's 250MB function limit. model/*.onnx is
# generated by training/convert_to_onnx.py from the original Keras .h5.
onnxruntime>=1.17.0

# opencv-python-headless drops the GUI/Qt bindings the server never calls.
opencv-python-headless>=4.6.0
numpy>=1.23.0,<2.0.0
